plugin.note: Shades are undead, so a salve amulet (e) applies and boosts melee. Loar Shades in Mort'ton are the fastest kill. A 40% weakness to wind spells means Wind Bolt outdamages Crumble Undead for the same chaos rune at 35+ Magic.

requirements: Combat level 30 is required to be assigned Shades by Mazchna (no Slayer level).
Priest in Peril is required to access Mort'ton for the fast Loar Shades.
A salve amulet (e) is recommended, as Shades are undead.
mechanics: Shades are undead: the salve amulet and Crumble Undead apply.
Loar and Catacombs-of-Kourend Shades have a 40% weakness to wind spells; Wind Bolt beats Crumble Undead per chaos rune at 35+ Magic.
Loar Shades (Mort'ton) are the fastest kill; Catacombs-of-Kourend Shades give more Slayer XP and are safespottable.
Stronghold of Security Shades have drastically reduced combat XP (1 XP per 10 damage) and only 4.2 Slayer XP; avoid them.

methods.label: Loar Shades with salve amulet
methods.summary: Kill Loar Shades in Mort'ton with melee and a salve amulet (e) for the fastest completion.
requiredOrKeyItems: A strong melee weapon (abyssal whip / dragon scimitar)
steps: Complete Priest in Peril and travel to Mort'ton.
Equip a salve amulet (e) and attack the Loar Shades with melee.
Continue until the task is complete; Loar Shades die quickly.
notes: Loar Shades have only 38 Hitpoints and hit up to 4, so little food is needed.

methods.label: Wind spells
methods.summary: Cast Wind Bolt to exploit the 40% wind weakness, better than Crumble Undead per chaos rune at 35+ Magic.
steps: Travel to Mort'ton (Loar) or the Catacombs of Kourend (level-140 Shades).
Cast Wind Bolt to exploit the 40% wind weakness.
In the Catacombs, use a safespot to avoid melee damage.
notes: Crumble Undead also works (undead), but Wind Bolt does more damage for the same chaos rune.
